trigger: pommelStruck — engine/combat.js#playerStrike and #memberStrike (a landed Pommel Strike blow that leaves the target standing)
before: The pommel finds Viper's temple. Viper loses its next turn, and will need a moment.
after: The pommel follows through to Viper's temple. Viper sees stars and loses its next turn.
why: Player report #4 ("A pommel strike seems kind of pointless ... It's a wash.") and the 2026-09-30 ruling: Pommel Strike is a real strike that also stuns. The stun now follows a landed blow, whose own hit line already said the damage, so this line reads as the follow-through (the pommel on the way past, the target seeing stars) and then states the lost turn. A Joiner's name still leads the line.
